name: search_activities
description: Bundestag/Bundesrat parliamentary activities filtered by GND subject descriptor (e.g. "Klimaschutz", "Mindestlohn") + optional ministry/date. Topic matching uses DIP subject descriptors (controlled German vocabulary) — pass a precise German subject term. For full document search use search_drucksachen instead.

query.description: GND subject descriptor — a precise German subject term, e.g. "Klimaschutz", "Mindestlohn" (matched against DIP's controlled vocabulary, not free text)

descriptor.description: Alias for query — GND subject descriptor (e.g. "Klimaschutz")

name: search_drucksachen
description: German Bundestag DIP (Dokumentations- und Informationssystem für Parlamentarische Vorgänge) — search Drucksachen, the printed papers of the Bundestag and Bundesrat: Gesetzentwürfe (bills), Anträge (motions), Beschlussempfehlungen and the government's written answers to Kleine Anfragen. The free-text query matches document titles, with optional Drucksachentyp and date range, cursor-paginated. Answers which German parliamentary documents deal with a topic, and when they were tabled.

name: search_plenarprotokolle
description: List Bundestag plenary protocols (transcripts) by date range. NOT keyword-searchable — protocol titles are only session numbers, so for a topic use search_drucksachen; open a specific protocol with get_plenarprotokoll.

name: get_plenarprotokoll
description: Fetch full detail for a single Bundestag plenary protocol (Plenarprotokoll) by its numeric id string — returns date, session number, and associated agenda items and speakers.

name: search_persons
description: List people referenced in DIP (members, ministers, witnesses), paginated by cursor. NOTE: DIP provides no name search — you cannot filter /person by name. To find a specific person, locate them via search_drucksachen (documents/activities reference persons).
